messages:
zara (People Ops): Quick note: we've rolled out an updated PTO carryover policy and a small handbook clarifying flexible work stipends. Managers need to verify their team ack by 2026-09-10. Summary + diff: https://go.redwood/hr/handbook-pto-stipend-2026

drew (People Ops): TL;DR: PTO carryover cap moves from 40 to 50 hours for full-time after 2026-01-01; flexible work stipend guidance added for hybrid employees. Please confirm in the sheet.

michelle (Legal): Legal approved wording; added a clause for country-specific tax treatment. If your country needs a different tax note, flag it in the "local_tax" column so Legal can advise.

frank (Benefits): Benefits note: stipend eligibility was prefilled. Managers, check eligibility column and correct any mistakes; mark corrections with a 1-line reason. Payroll will process stipend changes in the Oct run if confirmed by the deadline.

nina (EM): Do contractors on long-term contracts (>=6 months) count for stipend eligibility? We've got a couple on my team.

zara (People Ops): Contractors on payroll through Redwood who are full-time equivalent >=0.8 are eligible for stipend. Others mark exempt and add note.

simon (Hiring Ops): Ops: new offers after 2026-08-01 should include the updated stipend language. Hiring will add the snippet to offer templates by EOD.

ack-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-09-03T09:00Z  autopulse to managers with >2 unconfirmed acks.

drew (People Ops): Manager checklist: 1) Review per-manager CSV in `handbook_ack_exports/2073456789_manager_csvs.zip`; 2) Confirm acks by 2026-09-10; 3) Note any local tax variants or stipend corrections in the tracker.

zara (People Ops): Copyable team message: `Heads-up: small handbook updates to PTO carryover and flexible work stipends. Please review and ack by Sep 10. Managers  confirm in the shared tracker.`

nina (EM): Will post. Can you drop the per-manager CSV now?

drew (People Ops): Done  uploaded to the People Ops folder. If you need a contractor-only slice DM me. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
